description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Critical Damage +50%] to all allies, grants [Attach Ice], [Awoken Retainer], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Master of Arms Mode] to the user

description.name: Critical Damage +50%
description.text: Critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient)

description.name: Attach Ice
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Ice damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Ice resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Retainer
description.text: Knight and Samurai abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Knight and Samurai abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Master of Arms Mode
description.text: Instant cast speed for Ice abilities, casts Ice Blow after using two Ice abilities, removed after casting Ice Blow
